profile.headline: Cloud & Healthcare IT Architect | .NET Core, React, Angular | GCP/AWS Migration & FHIR Integration
profile.summary:
I've spent the last 20+ years solving business problems with code — from Oracle databases and PL/SQL in the early 2000s to building serverless microservices on Google Cloud today.

Right now I lead a team at WellSky, a healthcare technology company, where we build the FHIR-based systems that keep patient data compliant, portable, and secure. I helped lead our migration from AWS to GCP, built a service handling 5 million transactions an hour, and — honestly — I get as much satisfaction out of mentoring the next generation of engineers on my team as I do shipping the systems themselves.

Before that, I spent six years as a Solutions Architect designing data warehouses, integrating CRM/ERP/EMR systems (Salesforce, Epic, Oracle EBS), and building the BI pipelines that executives actually trust.

What ties it all together: I like taking a messy, ambiguous business problem and turning it into a system that works — whether that's cloud architecture, full-stack development (React, Angular, .NET Core), data integration, or modernizing something that's been held together with duct tape for a decade.

I'm also open to select freelance and consulting work — cloud migrations, custom application development, data integration, and modernizing systems that have outgrown their original design. If you've got a problem in that space, let's talk.

positions.title: Team Lead / Sr. Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: C# · Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) · Cloud Computing · Data Integration · Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) · Terraform · Serverless Computing · Data Architecture · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · .NET Core · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Team Lead / Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led design and development of a .NET Core microservice managing transactions into a Google Cloud FHIR Server — serverless, security-hardened infrastructure supporting 5 million transactions per hour.

 • Built a FHIR-compliant patient data module to satisfy compliance requirements, using React with an Angular wrapper so the component could be reused across both frameworks.

 • Led the migration of FHIR bundles from AWS S3 to a Google Cloud FHIR Server using .NET Core, helping drive WellSky's shift from AWS to GCP as its primary cloud platform for serverless architecture.

 • Built a .NET Core microservice to read and update FHIR bundles from AWS S3, secured with OAuth2, deployed to AWS EKS via Azure Pipelines CI/CD, with infrastructure managed in Terraform.

 • Led development of an internal API catalog microservice, making company-wide APIs discoverable and consumable across teams.

 • Continued building microservices for ongoing business initiatives on GCP, maintaining Terraform-managed infrastructure and Azure Pipelines CI/CD through the platform transition.

 • Grew into the team's Team Lead role across multiple rounds of turnover, becoming the go-to mentor for developing junior and new engineers.

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description:
• Designed and built data warehouses and transactional data models across MS SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, and Azure SQL DB, consolidating data from disparate source systems into a single source of truth — working directly with business stakeholders to translate requirements into working data platforms.

• Designed and built enterprise application integration (EAI) architecture using SoftwareAG webMethods, including custom C# extraction pipelines for Salesforce data, plus additional data integration work using SSIS, DataStage, and Azure Data Factory.

• Designed and delivered end-to-end BI solutions — analytic cubes in SSAS (Multidimensional and Tabular) and IBM Transformer, surfaced through Power BI, Tableau, MicroStrategy, and Cognos.

• Built full-stack applications using Java, C#, Node.js, Angular, jQuery, CSS, and HTML.

• Worked extensively with Azure cloud infrastructure — Data Factory, Azure SQL DB, Backup, Gateway, and VNets.

• Deep familiarity with enterprise CRM, ERP, and EMR systems — JDE, Oracle EBS, Sage, Infor, Salesforce, and Epic — valuable context for cross-platform integration and migration work.
positions.insights: Skills: Solution Architecture · C# · Microsoft Power BI · ASP.NET Core · Angular · Serverless Computing · Data Architecture · Data Warehousing · Microservices · .NET Core · Microsoft Azure · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Project leader
positions.description:
• Owned end-to-end delivery of a legacy modernization project converting an ASP/VB application to .NET 2.0 (C#, Microsoft Enterprise Library) — including redesigning the database to be independent of business identifiers and migrating it from Oracle 8.1.7 to 9.1. Led project planning and resourcing, technical design, developer guidance, QA oversight, customer training, and production release scheduling.

• Owned the redesign of an eCommerce access-code delivery system, converting it from JSP/Servlet to J2EE and Struts on WebLogic 9.2 and building new web services for the eCommerce workflow. Directed application design, coordinated development and QA, supported user training, and managed production releases.

• Built an IP geolocation web service (.NET 2.0, Microsoft Enterprise Library) used across eCommerce sites to determine customer location.

• Owned requirements and technical direction for the Sales Representative Finder application, translating business needs into technical solutions in partnership with developers.

positions.title: Business Systems Analyst
positions.description:
• Owned the full project lifecycle for business system initiatives — gathering customer requirements, delivering technical designs to developers, coordinating development and QA, and building production release schedules.

• Designed, developed, and supported numerous Oracle databases, providing technical support and business solutions for ongoing customer requirements across business system teams.

• Served as application support lead for several back-office and external-facing web-based systems.

• Built internal reporting solutions using Crystal Reports Server and performed load testing across business applications.

positions.title: Business Systems Analysis
positions.description: Skills: C#

positions.title: web developer
positions.description: Skills: C#

positions.title: Sr. Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
• Served as technical lead for an Oracle database running on Unix Sun Solaris, driving ongoing schema changes and building a dynamic auditing system in PL/SQL, including writing specifications and tests for all database changes.

• Led the migration of a marketing web application from PowerBuilder to a web-based platform (DHTML, ASP, VB, COM+), then led requirements gathering, design, and development for its ongoing enhancements — including a custom feature to import Word documents into Oracle by parsing them to XML and styling with XSL. Supported a user base of 75–100.

• Built automated and ad-hoc data-loading tools in Java and VB to load and update data on nightly schedules and per user-specific requirements.

• Maintained and supported the JDE-to-Oracle data feed using PRO-C.

• Supported and extended the company's Sales Representative Finder application (Java Servlets, JSP), including redesigning its data schema to add further functionality.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Developed client web applications as part of project teams, working across Java (Servlets, JSP), ASP, VBScript, JavaScript, SQL, and XML/XSL on both Windows and UNIX platforms.

• Built the front-end — dynamic JavaScript menus, HTML, VBScript, ASP — for a dynamic website for a manufacturing company client.

• Contributed to a global team building an eCommerce site for Procter & Gamble's Femcare division, developing an XML/XSL-based document generator that formatted customer order data into a printed insert shipped with purchases.

• Built a Java/Servlets/JSP application on UNIX for an internet startup connecting students, teachers, administrators, and parents — including a dynamic school-profile setup feature for administrators.

positions.description: Handled accounts payable transactions
